mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) consistently indicates stronger economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the absolute level.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negatively correlated with HOUST (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate at 0.14% as of 2013-03-15
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profits and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% signals robust job growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through enhanced consumer spending and business investment.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases by >0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS above 400,000 million) indicate robust consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through higher corporate revenues and earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 400000.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate at 0.14% as of 2013-03-15
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change < 0.5%) indicates a healthy demand environment without monetary tightening, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increases and CPIAUCSL annual change < 0.5%.
